request.amount_ada: 9,832,979 ADA stated in the anchor document; treasury_amount_lovelace is missing in the deterministic assessment.
request.deadline: 18 months of operations including transition period, with milestones from Q3 2026 through 2027.
deliverables: Legally establish a not-for-profit entity or sign a host-organization agreement under the preliminary board.
Publish technical transition architecture and migration plan for community review.
Hold a board election via on-chain voting under publicly published rules.
Serve all public API traffic for mainnet, preview, and preprod from the new stack.
Legally transfer Blockfrost source code, trademarks, domain names, and associated assets to the governing entity.
Open public consultation on long-term sustainability and publish a proposal for community feedback.
Operate the public API at minimum 99% monthly uptime and publish quarterly technical and budget reports.
request.recipient: Input Output / Blockfrost transition administered through Intersect and CDH contract structures, with the eventual governing not-for-profit entity not yet determined.
request.what: Transition Blockfrost into a free, community-governed public API/public good under an independent not-for-profit, with 18 months of transition and operations funding.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 9,832,979 ADA, described as 1,868,266 USD at 0.19 USD per ADA, for 18 months of Blockfrost transition and operations.
The proposal says Blockfrost will become a free, community-governed public API covering Cardano mainnet, preview, and preprod networks.
The proposal says all Blockfrost intellectual property, including source code, trademarks, domains, and associated assets, will be transferred to the governing not-for-profit entity.
The proposal cites Cardano Foundation developer ecosystem survey links showing Blockfrost hosted-platform usage rising from 39.3% in 2022 to 71.5% in 2025.
The proposal states Blockfrost served 781k unique visitors, more than 1.84 billion API requests, almost 700 requests per second, and over 7 TB of API data last month.
The proposal states that in most Cardano epochs more than 50% of all transactions are submitted through Blockfrost.
The proposed governance model includes a five-seat board with four seats for open-source infrastructure development entities and one open community seat, preceded by a named preliminary board.
The budget allocates 79.1% to staffing for six people, 19.3% to operations and infrastructure at about 20,000 USD per month, and 1.6% to legal and accounting.
The proposal says unspent post-transition infrastructure budget will be returned to the treasury and quarterly reports will publish technical data and budget summaries.
The proposal states milestone acceptance will be supported by a third-party assurer, with progress monitored through Intersect's delivery assurance function and budget management smart contracts.

summary: The document presents a large treasury request to convert Blockfrost from commercial ownership into a community-governed not-for-profit public API, with substantial claimed ecosystem reliance, a staged transition plan, proposed governance, budget categories, reporting, assurance, and sustainability concepts, but the deterministic assessment reports the treasury withdrawal amount in lovelace is missing.
